ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Gaussian Query Rendering for Sparse4D Pre-training
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D (ResNet-50, 900 queries) on unlabeled sweeps from nuScenes and Waymo Open. Learned queries decode small sets of 3D Gaussians that are splatted into neighboring camera views, and photometric plus rendered-depth consistency gives the queries positions without a BEV map. Train for 24 epochs, then fine-tune the detection head on 10% of box labels in either dataset and report mAP and NDS against random-weight training with all labels.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, image-backbone-only loading, and a masked-autoencoder backbone pre-trained for matched epochs; arms share a fine-tuning recipe and 3 seeds.
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP gain at 10% labels, shrinking with full labels; it fails if queries collapse to image-center positions, shown by a flat rendering loss.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Depth Teacher Distillation into SparseBEV Queries
PROPOSAL: Distill a frozen monocular depth model (ViT-L) into SparseBEV (ResNet-101, 900 queries) using unlabeled nuScenes sweeps. Query reference points are projected into 6 cameras, and features sampled there are regressed to teacher depth and teacher patch embeddings. Train for 60 epochs, then fine-tune on 10% of box labels and report mAP and NDS against random-weight training with all labels, using 5 seeds for the pre-trained arm and 5 for the random arm.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, image-backbone-only loading, and a contrastive pre-train at matched epochs; arms share a fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: Expect about 2 mAP gain at 10% labels with little left at full labels; it fails if teacher errors at long range propagate, visible as a drop on distant boxes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Next-Frame Query Propagation as Pre-training for SparseBEV
PROPOSAL: Pre-train SparseBEV (ResNet-50) on unlabeled nuScenes video by predicting, from ego-motion alone, where the queries of frame t land in frame t+1, and by matching the propagated queries to those the model produces from the next images. A feature consistency loss and a position loss supervise the match without labels. Run 20 epochs, then fine-tune for 3D detection with 20% of labels and report mAP and NDS together with velocity error against training from scratch.
CONTROLS: Training from scratch, ImageNet backbone loading, and a variant that propagates queries without ego-motion; a shared fine-tuning recipe and 3 seeds.
COST: 800
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mAP gain and a clearer gain in velocity error; it fails when static scenes dominate and propagation is trivial, so that no arm separates.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Masked Query Reconstruction with a ViT-B Backbone for SparseOcc
PROPOSAL: Pre-train SparseOcc with a ViT-B image backbone on unlabeled sweeps from nuScenes, Waymo Open and Argoverse 2 by masking 50% of the queries and reconstructing their features from the remaining queries and the image tokens. A cosine loss on the masked queries and a rendered-depth loss on the visible ones supervise the model. Run 40 epochs on the pooled sweeps, then fine-tune on Occ3D-nuScenes with 20% of labels and report mIoU against training from scratch, with 8 seeds in the final comparison.
CONTROLS: Training from scratch, ImageNet backbone loading, and an unmasked reconstruction variant; a shared fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 800
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mIoU gain; it fails if the masked-query loss is solved by copying neighbors, so that the gain vanishes when the mask ratio rises to 75%.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Shared Pre-training for Heterogeneous Query Decoders
PROPOSAL: Pre-train a ResNet-50 backbone with a query-agnostic objective: sampled 3D points are projected into the images, and features at their projections are trained to predict neighboring-frame colors and rendered depth. Transfer the same weights into DETR3D, PETR and Sparse4D, which initialize queries differently, and fine-tune each detector on nuScenes with 25% of labels. Report mAP and NDS per detector against random initialization, using the same pre-training weights for all three.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and a masked-autoencoder backbone at matched epochs; fine-tuning recipes follow the public configurations, with 3 seeds.
COST: 2400
PREDICTION: Expect gains of 1 to 3 mAP in all three detectors, highest for Sparse4D; it fails if gains appear only in the detector whose query layout matches the pre-training points.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Long-Schedule Query Pre-training of Sparse4D with a ViT-L Backbone
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D with a ViT-L backbone on unlabeled nuScenes sweeps for 100 epochs, decoding queries into Gaussians splatted into neighboring cameras under a photometric plus rendered-depth loss. Snapshots saved at regular intervals of the schedule are all fine-tuned with 25% of labels and scored by mAP and NDS against random initialization, using 5 seeds for the final snapshot. The temporal structure of the scene is left to the photometric term alone, with no separate motion loss.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and a contrastive ViT-L pre-train at matched epochs; the fine-tuning recipe follows the public configuration.
COST: 2400
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP gain that rises with schedule length until a late snapshot; it fails if later snapshots degrade fine-tuning, which would indicate overfitting to rendering.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Sparse Point Depth Rendering for OPUS Pre-training
PROPOSAL: Pre-train OPUS (ResNet-50) on a 20% subset of unlabeled nuScenes sweeps. Predicted occupancy points are projected into the 6 cameras, and the rendered depth of the points is compared with a self-supervised depth estimate from neighboring frames; a smoothness term keeps the points on surfaces. Train for 12 epochs, then fine-tune on Occ3D-nuScenes with 10% of labels and report mIoU against training from scratch.
CONTROLS: Training from scratch, ImageNet loading, and a variant without the smoothness term; a shared fine-tuning recipe, 3 seeds.
COST: 400
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mIoU gain at 10% labels; it fails if the estimated depth is too noisy in night scenes, leaving no gain on those splits.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Semantic Rendering Pre-training of SparseOcc on the Training Split
PROPOSAL: Pre-train SparseOcc (ResNet-101) on the unlabeled nuScenes training split, using a rendered-depth loss and a semantic feature loss against a frozen 2D segmentation model whose masks are projected onto the sparse occupancy points. Train for 36 epochs with 900 queries, then fine-tune on Occ3D-nuScenes with 10% of labels and report mIoU against scratch training, rerunning the best configuration with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Training from scratch, ImageNet loading, and a variant without the semantic term but with the same depth loss; a shared fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 400
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mIoU gain; it fails if the segmentation model transfers poorly to night frames, so that the semantic term adds noise rather than structure.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Ego-Motion Matched Query Contrast for PETR
PROPOSAL: Pre-train PETR (ResNet-50, 900 queries) on unlabeled nuScenes video with a contrastive objective on queries: a query at frame t is warped by ego-motion and treated as the positive of the query closest in 3D at frame t+1. A 3D position head on the queries gives a regression loss against positions triangulated from the two frames. Train for 20 epochs, then fine-tune on 10% of box labels and report mAP and NDS against training from random weights.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet backbone loading, and a contrastive variant that uses image-level positives; a shared fine-tuning recipe and 3 seeds.
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mAP gain at 10% labels; it fails if queries are matched through appearance alone, where the position head adds nothing and the image-level variant matches it.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Gaussian Rendering Pre-training Transferred to Sparse Detectors
PROPOSAL: Pre-train PETR (ResNet-101, 900 queries) on unlabeled sweeps from nuScenes and Waymo Open by decoding queries into 3D Gaussians splatted into neighboring cameras, with photometric and depth losses for 30 epochs on the pooled sweeps. Fine-tune the checkpoint into PETR, Sparse4D and SparseBEV with 10% of box labels and report mAP and NDS for all three against random weights and ImageNet loading, adding a longer 60-epoch pre-training arm for Sparse4D.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet backbone loading, and a masked-autoencoder backbone at matched epochs; fine-tuning recipes follow public configurations, 3 seeds.
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP gain in PETR and smaller gains in the other two; it fails if the gain disappears once the downstream query layout differs from the pre-training one.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Unified Detection and Occupancy Pre-training from Unlabeled Fleets
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D and OPUS with a shared ViT-B backbone on unlabeled sequences from nuScenes, Waymo Open and Argoverse 2. Queries decode Gaussians splatted into neighboring frames, with photometric and rendered-depth losses plus a temporal consistency loss on consecutive query sets. Train for 30 epochs, then fine-tune detection with 10% of box labels and occupancy with 10% of voxel labels on nuScenes, reporting mAP, NDS and mIoU against random initialization and ImageNet loading, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, a temporal-consistency-only variant, and a rendering-only variant; fine-tuning recipes follow public configurations.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP and a 1 to 2 mIoU gain; it fails if the shared backbone trails task-specific pre-training, in which case separate runs are preferable.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Query Rendering Pre-training of Sparse4D with ViT-L on nuScenes
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D with a ViT-L backbone on unlabeled nuScenes sequences, decoding queries into 3D Gaussians splatted into neighboring frames with photometric and rendered-depth losses. Train for 120 epochs and keep checkpoints along the schedule, then fine-tune the final checkpoint on 10% of box labels and report mAP and NDS against random initialization and ImageNet loading, using 8 seeds so that gains are separated from seed noise.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, a masked-autoencoder ViT-L at matched epochs, and a variant without the depth loss; the fine-tuning recipe follows the public configuration.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP gain; it fails if the longer schedule only fits rendering details, with no further downstream gain after epoch 80.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Linear Probes on Query Features after Rendering Pre-training
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D (ResNet-50) on unlabeled nuScenes sweeps with query-decoded Gaussian rendering for 10 epochs, then freeze the model and train linear probes on query features that predict object center, class and box size from 10% of labels. Report probe error and class accuracy against probes on randomly initialized queries and on ImageNet-loaded ones, and follow with a full fine-tune of the pre-trained arm on 10% of labels, reporting mAP and NDS.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and shuffled-label probes to set the chance floor; probes use a fixed optimizer setup and 3 seeds.
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Expect probe center error to fall by about 20% against random queries; it fails if probes recover position only from image coordinates and not from learned query content.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Frame-Pair Photometric Pre-training of DETR3D with a Swin-B Backbone
PROPOSAL: Pre-train DETR3D with a Swin-B backbone on unlabeled sweeps from nuScenes and Waymo Open: queries predict 3D reference points, features at the projections in the next frame are warped back, and a photometric reconstruction loss supervises the points. Run 40 epochs with a cosine learning-rate schedule, then fine-tune on 10% of box labels and report mAP and NDS against random initialization and ImageNet loading, with 5 seeds for the pre-trained arm.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and a variant without the warping step; a fixed fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mAP gain at 10% labels; it fails if the photometric loss is dominated by static background, leaving moving objects unchanged.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Lifting Frozen 2D Query Pre-training to 3D Sparse Detection
PROPOSAL: Initialize Sparse4D (ResNet-50) from a image-space query pre-training in the style of Frozen-DETR, then continue on unlabeled nuScenes sweeps with a 3D lifting stage: query reference points get depth through a rendered-depth head supervised by neighboring-frame reprojection. Train the lifting stage for 24 epochs and fine-tune on 10% of box labels, reporting mAP and NDS against the image-only initialization and random weights.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, image-only query pre-training with no lifting stage, and ImageNet loading; a shared fine-tuning recipe, 3 seeds.
COST: 2000
PREDICTION: Expect lifting to add 1 to 2 mAP above the image-only initialization; it fails if image-space pre-training already supplies most of the gain, so that the lifting stage is not needed.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Reprojection Pre-training with ViT-L Teacher Features for Sparse4D
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D (ResNet-101) on unlabeled nuScenes sweeps by sampling image features at projected query reference points and regressing frozen ViT-L patch features from 3 neighboring frames, with a reprojection loss on rendered depth. Train for 50 epochs, then fine-tune on 10% of box labels and report mAP and NDS against random weights and ImageNet loading, with 5 seeds, and a final run with 25% of labels for the best checkpoint.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and a variant that regresses color instead of teacher features; a shared fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 2000
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 mAP gain at 10% labels that narrows at 25%; it fails if teacher features carry appearance only, so that the 3D structure is not learned.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Label-Fraction Curve for Query Pre-training of SparseBEV
PROPOSAL: Pre-train SparseBEV (ResNet-50) on unlabeled nuScenes sweeps with Gaussian rendering for 16 epochs, then fine-tune with 5%, 10%, 25% and 100% of box labels and report mAP and NDS per fraction against random weights, to show how much annotation the pre-training replaces. An ImageNet-loaded arm is fine-tuned at a subset of fractions for reference.
CONTROLS: Random initialization at all fractions, ImageNet loading at a subset of fractions, and a rendering-free temporal variant; a shared recipe and 3 seeds.
COST: 900
PREDICTION: Expect the gain to reach 3 mAP at 5% labels and to fall below 1 mAP at 100%; it fails if the curve is flat, which would show that the pre-training adds nothing beyond the backbone.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Occupancy Pre-training of OPUS with Rendered Semantics
PROPOSAL: Pre-train OPUS (ResNet-101) on unlabeled sweeps from nuScenes and Waymo Open, rendering predicted occupancy points into the 3 neighboring cameras and matching depth and a pseudo semantic map from a frozen segmenter. Train for 40 epochs with a warm-up phase, then fine-tune on Occ3D-nuScenes with 10% of labels and report mIoU against scratch training and ImageNet loading, with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Training from scratch, ImageNet loading, and a variant that renders depth only; a shared fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 900
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mIoU gain; it fails if pseudo semantics are inconsistent across the two datasets, so that the semantic term cancels its own benefit.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Transfer from Detection Pre-training into Sparse Occupancy Heads
PROPOSAL: Pre-train Sparse4D (ResNet-50) on unlabeled nuScenes and Waymo Open sweeps with Gaussian rendering for 24 epochs, then reuse the backbone and query encoder to initialize SparseOcc and OPUS, whose decoders differ. Fine-tune both on Occ3D-nuScenes with 10% of labels and report mIoU against random weights, and test whether freezing the query encoder for the first 4 epochs changes the gain.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and a backbone-only transfer arm; a shared fine-tuning recipe, 3 seeds.
COST: 1800
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mIoU gain in both occupancy models; it fails if the gain is carried by the backbone alone, with no added value from the query encoder.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Longer Rendering Schedule for SparseOcc with a ViT-B Backbone
PROPOSAL: Pre-train SparseOcc with a ViT-B backbone on unlabeled nuScenes sweeps, decoding queries into Gaussians splatted into neighboring cameras, for 80 epochs. Fine-tune on Occ3D-nuScenes with 10% of labels and report mIoU against random weights and ImageNet loading, using 8 seeds for the final comparison and 3 seeds for checkpoints saved during training.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet loading, and a variant that skips the rendering loss; a shared fine-tuning recipe.
COST: 1800
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mIoU gain that grows with schedule length; it fails if early checkpoints already match the final one, which would show the longer schedule is not helping.
